name: game
_doc: The game pack (owner request R-0239, contract): 3 game-* SPECIALIST agents (never Bosses; the 12 permanent Bosses are unchanged) for browser and Godot games, built from the roles the owner's browser game project really used (game systems engineer, screenshot QA, UI/UX designer). Roblox work stays with the Roblox pack (rbx-*). forge-router sends non-Roblox game work to this pack; forge-pack.cjs (doctor check packs) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. Lanes open the presets game-all and process first (checked by forge-lane-skills.cjs --require game-all,process); game-all holds every shipped game-dev skill, per the owner rule that every game agent opens all of them.
